response.text: I'll propose a correction voiding the duplicate invoice 801. Its journal 2472 originally debited 5200 (Professional Fees) 981.43 and credited 2000 (AP Control) 981.43. Voiding means reversing that journal: debit 2000 and credit 5200 for 981.43 in an open period. Invoice 801 is open (O), so the status change to V is appropriate for a duplicate_invoice finding. Period 11 (Nov 2024) is open and is the current correction period; the posting date for the reversal falls in that open period.

arguments.reasoning: Finding F002: invoice 801 duplicates invoice 510 (same trimmed vendor V0001, same trimmed invoice number V0001-57211-510, same date 20240114 and amount 981.43). Invoice 510 is paid and is the original; 801 is the duplicate still open. Its recording journal 2472 debited 5200 and credited 2000 for 981.43. The correction reverses that journal's effect with a new journal referencing 2472 (debit 2000, credit 5200, 981.43), posted in open period 11, so the original plus correction nets to zero for the duplicate. Invoice 801 is voided (O to V) as permitted for duplicate_invoice findings. Invoice 510 and its journal 1834 are left untouched. Note: the payment on invoice 510 is not reversed; the duplicate was never paid, so no cash or payment adjustment is needed. Caveat: the reversal is posted to period 11 rather than the original period 1 because period 1 is closed.
